Ulla Dam-Schmidt is a specialized nurse (Sygeplejerske med klinisk specialfunktion, SD, MKS) affiliated with Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg Hospital [^src2]. She plays a central leadership role in Danish cardiovascular quality assurance as a co-chair and chairperson (*forperson*) for the steering committee of the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src1]. In this capacity, she represents the nursing perspective in national quality development, ensuring that patient pathways, structured education, and interdisciplinary collaboration are embedded in the database's professional recommendations [^src4].

Her ongoing involvement in the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] is documented consistently across multiple annual national quality reports. She is listed as a co-chair of the steering committee in the 2023 report alongside medical doctors Lars Frost and Albert Marni Joensen [^src1]. By the 2024 and 2025 reports, she is explicitly named as the chairperson (*forperson*) for the database and a continuing member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] [^src3], [^src5]. Through her work, she contributes to the broader national strategy of shifting from hospital-centered to population-based quality measurement and improving structured patient education in the treatment of [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src4], [^src6].
